info.title: AIHub GPT companion surface
info.description: Intentionally-empty override slot for GPT-oriented tooling. As of the 06.07 repair sprint, GET /gpt-openapi.json in aihub/main.py ignores this file whenever its 'paths' is empty (as here) and instead serves the LIVE OpenAPI schema generated from the running app (app.openapi() - same content as GET /openapi.json). To serve a curated subset instead, replace this file's 'paths' with real, non-empty entries, or point AIHUB_GPT_OPENAPI_PATH at a different file with real paths.
